title: Sunshine Market
audience: Chinese junior students (13-15 years old, average level in mainland China)
imageAlt: A colorful busy street market with fruit stalls, students and shoppers
imageDescription: A vibrant outdoor street market on a sunny day. In the foreground, three students Li Wei (14), Sarah (14) and Chen (15) stand at a fruit stall piled with oranges, bananas, dragon fruits and watermelons. Li Wei holds an orange and smiles at Sarah. Behind them, another student Zhang holds a camera near the Sunshine Fruits stall with apples and bananas. The market is crowded with vendors and shoppers, with signs for Fresh Market, Bakery, Fish Market, Clothes, Handicrafts and Toys & Gifts. Colorful flags decorate the street.
scoringDescription: A vibrant outdoor street market on a sunny day under a bright blue sky with a few white clouds and strong sunlight casting short shadows. In the foreground, three students Li Wei (14) holding an orange and smiling at Sarah (14), and Chen (15) stand closely together at a fruit stall piled high with oranges, bananas, dragon fruits and watermelons, laughing and appearing happy. Behind them, student Zhang stands near the Sunshine Fruits stall displaying apples and bananas, holding a black camera with both hands and aiming it toward the fruit stall as if preparing to take a photo. The market is crowded and busy with vendors and shoppers walking between stalls. Visible signs read Fresh Market, Bakery, Fish Market, Clothes, Handicrafts and Toys & Gifts, indicating many other goods besides fruits. Colorful triangular flags decorate the street above, and most people wear short sleeves and light clothing, confirming warm sunny weather. The open-air stalls offer affordable fresh produce but are crowded and noisy, showing both the lively charm and the limited space of street markets.
